correctness.rationale: Fix k≥2 and b_i≥1, choose pivot p maximizing b_p. H(t)=((t_j-t_p) mod b_j) for j≠p maps the product of label alphabets onto C=prod_{j≠p}Z/b_j, and every fixed-coordinate slice still surjects: when nonpivot t_i fixed, choose t_p congruent to t_i−d_i mod b_i, possible since b_p≥b_i; other coordinates follow. |C|=min_i prod_{j≠i}b_j. Under |C|≥r, surject π:C→R; for each neighborhood tuple choose fallback point in common intersection. Outcome π(H(t)) when in intersection, fallback otherwise gives inclusion in each chosen neighborhood; common reachable range and slice surjectivity give reverse inclusion for each target point and fixed action. The one-neighborhood full-range frame forces each complement-product≥r by counting completion profiles. Independent exhaustive check of all 3-agent budgets b_i=1..4 confirmed surjectivity on every coordinate slice, including unit cases; universal theorem from constructive proof.
